Name: KCC - Kandis Cauldrons and Circles - Tilesheet
Author: KandiKraze
Description:
Need that Wizards cauldron but in a better color for your maps? Hoping to decorate but find that the wizards circle has too many candles on it? 

Why not try this out for size? Now with an abundance of cauldron types as well as colors! Silver, cream, gold, pink, light pink, or the basic cauldron. This is my first tilesheet so ty ty for any feedback you have.
